narrative: Wide receiver rooms took a beating this week: CeeDee Lamb is OUT with an ankle issue, Mike Evans is OUT with a hamstring, and Malik Nabers has moved from OUT to IR — so you can stop holding that roster spot. Davante Adams (hamstring) and Tetairoa McMillan (calf) are both Questionable, which means two more lineup decisions you won't get to make until Sunday morning. Carolina's backfield adds to the fog with Chuba Hubbard also Questionable on a calf. And the experts can't agree on Dak Prescott at all — Mike Harmon has him at #5 while Nathan Jahnke drops him to #21, a 6-to-20 range with a 3.13 standard deviation. When the rankings spread that wide, trust your own read on the matchup.
